mentions.name: Primavera UI
mentions.description: A collection of vanilla JavaScript UI components, including a drag-and-drop component, re-implemented from handwritten specs using AI-assisted coding with follow-up correction prompts. Early in development, with plans to keep updating the components and adding more.
mentions.source_excerpt: Last week I wrote the spec for a couple of vanilla JS https://danielgormly.github.io/primavera-ui/dnd/ that I've handwritten in the past. I used the spec to vibecode them + a few follow-up correction prompts.
